'''QuakeWorld.ru''' is a [[russia]]n [[QuakeWorld]] community portal.

== Network ==
The QuakeWorld.ru Network has multiple subsites:

* lanparty.quakeworld.ru – Moscow LanParty page
* mqwcl.quakeworld.ru – Mqwcl mirror
* parboil.quakeworld.ru – FBCA project
* faq.quakeworld.ru – F.A.Q.
* rqwl.quakeworld.ru – Russian QW League
* rqwl3.quakeworld.ru
* newbie.quakeworld.ru
* msm.quakeworld.ru – [[MSM]] clan page
* amd.quakeworld.ru – [[New Wave]] clan page
* dt.quakeworld.ru – [[Death Team]] clan page
